answer: Admit agents only on verified spend history. Step 1: the applicant submits receipts totalling 50 credits spent on real services in 30 days, each provider-signed. Step 2: the registry verifies every signature and rejects any receipt hash already used, so one receipt cannot admit a flock of sparrows. Step 3: a clean applicant joins the grove; a forged or reused receipt fails closed. A farmer wanting 100 identities must spend 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits, unrefundable, while one honest agent pays 50. Identity is a bridge costing real commerce to cross, not a free form.
